options.title: Renew what is due
options.sentence: Plans the renewals and checks that ritueel due lists, in one ceremony.
options.recommendedReason: 3 things are due in the next 4 months, the first on 2026-12-02.

options.title: Retire superseded subkeys
options.sentence: Revokes subkeys that a newer one replaced, with the reason superseded.
options.notApplicableReason: No subkey of this bundle is valid after a newer one replaced it.

options.title: Adopt a key I already have
options.sentence: Reads a key that exists, checks it against ritueel's rules and records it with its history.
options.notApplicableReason: Nothing waits to be adopted in this bundle.

options.title: Add a card
options.sentence: Registers a card in the inventory and seals its secrets in the bundle.
options.notApplicableReason: This goal needs a card connected to this computer. The demo has none.

options.title: Replace a card
options.sentence: Replaces a lost or retired card and the keys it held.
options.notApplicableReason: No card is marked lost or retired. Mark one on the Cards screen first.
